page.overview:
Who is The Baby Translator?

The Baby Translator is an invention made by Herb Powell.

After going bankrupt, Herb wanted to invent something that would make him rich again. While in a park, he saw a mother and her baby, which inspired him to create a device that could translate babies' cries. Since Herb had no money to launch his idea, he asked Homer for a $2000 cheque that Homer had received. After tinkering around and with the help of Maggie, Herb managed to build a working model. He demonstrated the machine using Maggie's babbling at the Baby EXPO, and earned a lot of money. As a display of gratitude towards his brother, Homer, for lending him the $2000, he forgave Homer for previously causing him to go bankrupt and gifted him the Spine Melter 2000.
